data.title: One app, from the first booking to the next one.
data.lead: Catch runs the whole life of an event: your page, bookings and payments, the door, the night itself and the follow-up. Use all of it, or start with one part.

items.d: A page that replaces the link in your bio.
Applications, waitlists, and UPI or card.
Reminders and updates that go out on time.
QR or self check-in on a phone or iPad.
Groups, teams, seating and rotations, by format.
Reviews, reports, payouts and who to invite back.

data.note: Rec 4 and 9: the product layer, now on the kit. Each step links to a capability page.

data.title: Get found, fill it, and tell people where to be.

list: Your links, upcoming events and photos in one place, for your Instagram bio
Events you run elsewhere appear as tiles that link out
Reviews from people who booked, with your replies, and followers who hear about your next event first
It may already exist: claim it free
Applications with the questions you ask, approved with a tap
Waitlists that fill places when someone drops out
Private offers and invite-only events
Prices that can change as an event fills
UPI or card, every payment next to the right name, refunds by your rules
Where to meet and a reminder the day before, sent for you
Messages to everyone booked, or to an audience you choose

media.alt: An event as guests see it on Catch

data.title: Open the door, then run the room.

list: QR or self check-in, on your phone or an iPad at the door
Arrivals, late-comers and walk-ins, live
Pace groups, tables, teams, court rotations or a route between venues, built for each format
A first hello, and Help me say hi for private introductions
Guests join live moments in their phone’s browser, no app needed
A dress rehearsal with your team before doors open

data.title: Know what worked, and who to invite back.

list: One record per guest across every event you run
Reviews and private feedback, with replies
A report after every event, and insights across them
Payouts, and roles for your team
The next invitation goes to the people most likely to come

data.title: Hand Catch as much of the evening as you want.

Applications, payments and reminders, with one record for every guest.
Your events appear where people in your city look for something to do.
